AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin poor kid
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born into a poor and destitute family, so [PAWN_pronoun] learned to take charge at a very young age. [PAWN_pronoun]'s lifelong dream is to have porridge and hot soup for every meal.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin kidnap victim
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was abducted by ratkin traders at a very young age. Fortunately, the buyer who selected [PAWN_pronoun] was more merciful, allowing [PAWN_pronoun] to grow up safely until now.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin punk
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a small-time thug who enjoys robbing other children of their money. [PAWN_pronoun] gradually stopped engaging in such activities after being publicly caught by a knight.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin fooling around soldier
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] doesn’t know what [PAWN_pronoun] is fighting for. [PAWN_possessive] favorite thing to do every day is to scavenge for leftover sugar cubes or cigarette butts with a gun in hand.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin brave soldier
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is brave in combat and miraculously survived countless battles. [PAWN_pronoun] has earned many honors, but they are not enough to feed [PAWN_nameDef] and [PAWN_possessive] family.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin student soldier
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a student soldier who responded to the call and left the campus. [PAWN_pronoun] had the opportunity to sit comfortably in a classroom and study, but [PAWN_possessive] passionate yet ignorant mind led [PAWN_pronoun] to give it all up.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Field Sister
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a nun providing support in frontline battles. Although [PAWN_pronoun] has acquired some combat skills in [PAWN_possessive] work, the bloody scenes encountered while assisting wounded soldiers have left an indelible imprint on [PAWN_pronoun], making [PAWN_pronoun] deeply disgusted by violence.
